script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. KITCHEN - DAY

JESSICA (30s, driven, ambitious) wipes down the countertop in her cramped apartment kitchen. She stares at a newspaper article about a tech startup, COSMO TECH, that recently received a multi-million-dollar investment.

JESSICA
(talking to herself)
This is it. I've got to get out of retail and into tech. I've got the skills, I've got the drive. I've just got to land an interview.

INT. RETAIL STORE - DAY

Jessica, wearing a bright red smock apron, handles customers' returns and exchanges. Her coworker, LUCY (early 30s, cynical), rolls her eyes as Jessica daydreams about her tech career.

LUCY
(sarcastically)
Oh, look at you, Jessica. Your dreams are just a LinkedIn profile away.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jessica sits at her laptop, typing up her resume and cover letter for Cosmo Tech. Her cat, MEOW-MEOW, lays curled up on the couch.

JESSICA
(to herself)
This is it, Meow-Meow. I'm going to make us proud.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jessica meets with her friend OLIVIA (early 30s, supportive, tech-savvy), who gives her advice on her job search.

OLIVIA
I've got it. An old colleague of mine works there. Let me send you their email address.

INT. JESSICA'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jessica frantically sends an email to her contact, ARTHUR (40s, friendly, influential), at Cosmo Tech. She checks her phone for a reply every five minutes.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Olivia sits with Jessica, who looks nervous and fidgety.

OLIVIA
Did you hear back from Arthur?

JESSICA
(shaking her head)
No. But I'm sure he's just busy.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jessica receives an email notification. She reads it with excitement.

JESSICA
(to herself)
Yes! I got an interview!

INT. COSMO TECH OFFICE - DAY

Jessica sits nervously in the reception area. She practices answering common interview questions. The receptionist, BEN (early 30s, friendly, accommodating), brings her into the interview room.

INT. INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY

Jessica interviews with ARTHUR, who is impressed by her resume and determination. They discuss her retail background and how it could apply to customer service roles in their company.

ARTHUR
I think you'd be a great fit, Jessica. Let me send you an offer.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jessica excitedly accepts the job offer and begins to pack for her first day at Cosmo Tech. Meow-Meow curiously inspects the new suitcase.

JESSICA
(to Meow-Meow)
We're going to make it, Meow-Meow. We're finally going to make it.

INT. COSMO TECH OFFICE - DAY

Jessica arrives at Cosmo Tech, looking professional and eager. She meets her new coworkers, including Lucy, who now works in marketing. They exchange pleasantries, and Jessica feels a sense of accomplishment.

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
